effects.does: Clicking Copy starts copying the current project.
effects.affects: It creates a cloned project record without changing the current event.
effects.leadsTo: A clone confirmation dialog or the cloned project's details screen.
effects.check: Click Copy and verify that a clone confirmation or newly created cloned project appears.

effects.does: Clicking the copy icon copies the associated value to the clipboard.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data or workflow.
effects.check: Click the icon and verify the expected identifier or value can be pasted elsewhere.

effects.does: Clicking Ask Clara opens Clara for analysis of the current project.
effects.affects: It creates or runs an analysis todo but does not directly change the event record.
effects.leadsTo: Clara analysis flow, potentially followed by the returned redirect URL.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify Clara starts analysis and, when completed, the UI follows the returned redirect URL.

effects.does: Clicking Create New Version starts creation of a new project version.
effects.affects: It creates a new draft-version workflow while preserving the existing project version.
effects.leadsTo: The project creation screen for the new version.
effects.check: Click Create New Version and verify the create screen opens with the new-version context.

effects.does: Clicking Messages opens the project's communication hub.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data; it only opens project communications.
effects.check: Click Messages and verify the communication drawer opens for this project.

effects.does: Clicking Hide fields hides optional fields in the current view.
effects.affects: Only the current view's field visibility; it does not change event data.
effects.check: Click Hide fields and verify the additional fields disappear and the control changes to show them again.

effects.does: Clicking Download Report downloads a report for the displayed project or bids.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data or workflow.
effects.leadsTo: stays here while a report file is downloaded.
effects.check: Click Download Report and verify a report download starts.

effects.does: Clicking Start Awarding begins the awarding flow when the lot is eligible.
effects.affects: It moves the event from bid review toward awarding, unless project or lot conditions disable awarding or a pending bid justification requires resolution.
effects.leadsTo: The awarding screen or a bid-justification modal.
effects.check: Click Start Awarding for an eligible lot and verify the awarding screen opens, or verify the documented disabling condition prevents the action.

effects.does: Clicking Project Details switches to the project's details overview.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data; it changes the selected project-details tab.
effects.check: Click Project Details and verify the overview content and tab selection change.

effects.does: Clicking the stage tab switches the project-details view to that stage.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data; it changes the active stage tab.
effects.leadsTo: The selected stage's details or QCS screen.
effects.check: Click the stage tab and verify its stage content is rendered and the tab is selected.

effects.does: Clicking Master QCS selects the master quotation comparison view.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data; it keeps the buyer in the master QCS stage view.
effects.check: Click Master QCS and verify it remains selected and the master QCS content is displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Project navigates back to the project-level page.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data or workflow.
effects.leadsTo: The project details or project listing screen.
effects.check: Click Project and verify the application leaves the current QCS view for the project-level screen.

effects.does: Clicking the vendor column opens that vendor's proposal or bid details.
effects.affects: Nothing in the bid record; it changes the review screen for the selected proposal.
effects.leadsTo: The proposal page for the vendor, or contract details when a non-draft contract exists.
effects.check: Click the vendor name and verify the corresponding proposal or contract-details route opens with the correct lot.
